column1: 2. Closed or Open? You decide whether you want a closed economy (which occurs when the capital flow CF always equals zero) or an open economy (which allows CF to differ from zero). 3. Small or Large? If you want an open economy, you decide whether you want a small one (in which CF is infinitely elastic at the world interest rate r∗) or a large one (in which the domestic interest rate is not pinned down by the world rate).
